The 1.005 entry 0x02a78014 has exactly two callers and both reference the 1.005 SQEXSEAD BGM manager singleton; enumerating xrefs to that singleton and to the known 1.004 singleton produced two four-function tail groups with identical relative offsets (+0, +0x38, +0x13c, +0x174) and identical intra-function xref offsets (+0x0d, +0x57). The two 1.004 callers decompile statement-for-statement identically to their 1.005 twins, including the -1.0f (0xbf800000) immediate in one and the fade-out local in the other, and each calls this entry exactly where its twin calls the cataloged 1.005 entry. The body then matches independently: it reads manager+0x48 (SqexSeadManager::current_slot), guards on manager+0x54 (::pause_count), swaps the fade value at slot+0x3c around the transition call, and increments the pause count - the same two manager fields bgm_manager_pause_detour snapshots via core::safe_read_field before and after forwarding. The 1.005 pattern matches zero sites in this image, so the locator was re-derived from this binary. It anchors the inlined FUObjectArray index-to-item idiom CMP EAX,[rip+num_elements] / JGE / CDQ / MOV ECX,0x10000 / IDIV ECX / MOVSXD RCX,EAX / MOVSXD RAX,EDX. The first match is RVA 0x0077e0b9, whose rel32 decodes to 0x0077e0b9 + 0x06 + 0x0816d40d = 0x088eb4cc, the cataloged object-count field; candidate adjustment 0x24 recovers the GUObjectArray base 0x088eb4a8.
